status.en: 30 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 77% more than the week before, most of them in Tigray, Amhara and Addis Ababa.
status.nb: 30 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 77 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Tigray, Amhara og Addis Ababa.

summary.en: Russian Su-35 fighter jets and S-400 air defence systems have arrived in Ethiopia as fighting intensifies in Tigray and the Amhara region. Airstrikes have been reported around Rama for a third consecutive day, while a drone strike hit the Hayiq Jari 2 IDP camp in Amhara, killing 16 civilians and injuring 22. Armed attackers killed at least 60 Orthodox Christians in Oromia and a drone hit a shelter in South Wollo Zone, causing further casualties. Major General Yohannes, a senior Tigray military commander, was captured near the Eritrean border. The UCDP recorded 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Russiske Su‑35‑jagerfly og S‑400‑luftforsvarssystemer har ankommet Etiopia etter hvert som kampene intensiveres i Tigray og Amhara-regionen. Luftangrep er rapportert rundt Rama for tredje dag på rad, mens et droneram rammet Hayiq Jari 2‑leiren for internt fordrevne i Amhara, og drepte 16 sivile og såret 22. Væpnede angripere drepte minst 60 ortodokse kristne i Oromia, og en drone traff et tilfluktssted i South Wollo-sonen, noe som forårsaket ytterligere skader. Generalmajor Yohannes, en høytstående tigrayisk militærkommandør, ble tatt til fange nær grensen mot Eritrea. UCDP registrerte 2 824 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Fano insurgency
background.extract: The Fano insurgency is an armed conflict and insurgency in the Amhara Region of Ethiopia that began in April 2023 between the Fano militia and the Ethiopian government. The conflict started after the government attempted to dissolve the Amhara Special Forces and other regional forces as part of a plan to reform and centralize the country's security apparatus, and integrate them into the federal armed forces. This move led to protests and armed resistance by local forces under Fano.
